With multiple `_calendar` references (possible after this refactor adds one per destination calendar), each remaining recurring booking's event would be deleted once per reference via that credential sweep — duplicate deletions. The mechanism is visible directly in the diff; exact severity is hard to fully verify without seeing runtime behavior.
